title: Saturday garden sessions
description: An afternoon of acoustic sets in a small neighbourhood garden. Bring a blanket and settle in. Food and drinks are available separately.

title: Clay club: make something imperfect
description: A relaxed introduction to hand-building ceramics. Materials and firing are included. No experience needed; pieces are ready to collect two weeks later.
accessibility: One step at the entrance. Seated activity.

title: Cinema under the last of the summer sky
description: An open-air screening of a fictional independent film, followed by a short conversation. Doors open at 19:45. Portuguese audio with English subtitles.
accessibility: Step-free entrance. Subtitles available. No audio description.

title: The tiny print fair
description: Meet local illustrators, browse small editions and try a five-minute printing activity. Entry is free; prints and workshops are priced by each stall.
accessibility: Ground-floor space with a narrow entrance. No accessible toilet.

title: Sunday listening room
description: A full album, played from start to finish on a lovely sound system. Phones away, conversations afterwards. The organiser has not supplied ticket pricing.
accessibility: Seating available. Venue access details not provided.

title: A slow walk by the river
description: A gentle four-kilometre group walk with stops for stories and sketching. Bring water and comfortable shoes. Meeting point: the blue kiosk beside the river.
accessibility: Mostly flat route with some uneven paving. Rest stops provided.

title: At the long table: a neighbourhood supper with stories from every kitchen
description: Three shared vegetarian courses and a seat beside someone new. Tell the organiser about allergies when booking. Drinks are not included.
accessibility: Step-free entrance and accessible toilet. Busy shared dining room.

title: Repair, reuse, repeat
description: Bring a small broken object and learn how to repair it with volunteers. Repairs depend on available parts and skills. Donations for materials are welcome.
accessibility: Step-free workshop. Ear defenders available on request.
